checks.name: incident response runbook
checks.message: Incident response runbook should define severity, roles, communication, and postmortems.

checks.name: incident template
checks.message: Incident template should capture severity, commander, timeline, and customer impact.

checks.name: postmortem template
checks.message: Postmortem template should capture root cause, impact, action items, and follow-up ownership.

checks.name: rollback runbook
checks.message: Rollback runbook should cover feature flags, deployment rollback, database decisions, and validation.

checks.name: secret leak runbook
checks.message: Secret leak runbook should cover revoke, rotate, audit, and notification steps.

checks.name: incident issue template
checks.message: GitHub incident issue template should exist for tracking incidents.

checks.name: release checklist incident coverage
checks.message: Release checklist should include incident readiness, restore readiness, and rollback decision checks.

checks.name: production workflow incident gate
checks.message: Production deploy workflow should run incident and restore readiness checks.
